item.title: Update on a security incident involving 1Password’s backend systems
item.description: 1Password identified a security incident involving some of our backend systems. Customer vaults were not accessed and remain secure. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Warp bets on the software factory
item.description: Zach Lloyd, founder and CEO of Warp, is back to talk about what he calls the company's primary bet: Warp Factories, open infrastructure for running a cloud software factory, which he calls the new version of CI/CD. (1 source: changelog)
